component.title: Toggle
component.purpose: Expose a persistent pressed state through the shared action-control grammar.

states.description: A toggle is available and off.
A controlled consumer receives pressed-state changes.
A toggle communicates its active mode.
An unavailable mode retains its label and state.

claims.statement: Toggle uses a native button with aria-pressed and keeps the shared ControlBase focus, hover, press, and reduced-motion behavior.
Controlled consumers receive exactly one pressed-state callback per activation.
